title: Nazi aneutronic fusion bomb traded away for amnesty

tellings.quote: >> If the Nazis developed that in 1944 to 45, >> Mhm. >> atom bombs would be like matches for them.

plain: The researcher Jason Jorjani suggests that in 1944 and 1945 the Nazis may have developed a kind of fusion bomb that gives off almost no radiation, so powerful that "atom bombs would be like matches" next to it. The story holds that this weapon was traded away in exchange for amnesty after the war. Jorjani lays it out as a theory, without naming a source, and if true it would mean the Allies quietly inherited a weapon beyond the atom bomb.
